title: Nourishing Cantonese Glutinous Rice Dan Dan Noodles
description: Earthy, flaky, and romantic Cantonese noodles made from glutinous rice flour, infused with savory soy, oyster sauce, and a subtle kick of Sichuan peppercorn oil, diabetic-friendly and perfect for lunch.
instructions: Mix glutinous rice flour, salt, and water to form a smooth dough; knead until elastic; cover and rest for 10 minutes.
Steam the dough in a steamer for 15 minutes; let it cool, roll into thin sheets, and cut into noodle strands.
Heat sesame oil in a wok over medium heat; add minced garlic and ginger; stir-fry until fragrant.
Add vegetable broth, soy sauce, and oyster sauce to the wok; bring to a gentle simmer.
Toss the steamed noodles into the broth; gently stir to coat all strands.
Stir in ground peanuts, sliced scallions, and Sichuan peppercorn oil; cook for 2 minutes until heated through.
Transfer the noodles into serving bowls; drizzle a little extra chili bean paste if desired; garnish with additional scallions.
Serve hot and enjoy the comforting flavors.
